description: Project supervision hooks for Codex audit and quality workflows.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $node) { $node = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'nodejs/node.exe' }; & $node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/session-start.mjs')"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $node) { $node = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'nodejs/node.exe' }; & $node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/subagent-start.mjs')"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $node) { $node = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'nodejs/node.exe' }; & $node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/subagent-stop.mjs') --advisory"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $node) { $node = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'nodejs/node.exe' }; & $node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs') --advisory"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; $node = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $node) { $node = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'nodejs/node.exe' }; & $node (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/stop-quality-gate.mjs')"
hooks.statusMessage: Running the Codex completion quality gate
